notes.title: Potions!
notes.content:
The latest update for Castle Clamber is now live! Here's a summary of what's included:

New features:

 New potion power ups with a variety of effects, each with its own advantage or disadvantage in different situations
 More achievements
 Updated background artwork
 Revamped menus with full controller support
 Analogue controller input now affects player movement
 Multi-threaded map loader for buttery smooth transitions


Fixes:

 Removed bbcode from news ticker
 Prevent showing incorrect level time if no personal best found
 Fix players sticking to crates when pushing them off the edge of a platform
 Fix players falling through more than one floor when dropping through a platform and touching a wall
 Fix being able to infinitely farm the Magic Hat for points
 Game is paused automatically when opening the steam overlay
 Game is paused automatically if a controller is disconnected
 Game starts in full screen mode when running steam in big picture


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383828/5015d2dd9d9c0cabaf10d54f4389fe9823e4803f.png

The most notable addition is the new potions - these drop at random from defeated enemies or broken crates. Collect one by running over it, and it'll cast its spell for a limited time. Each colour potion has a different effect which can help (or hinder!) the player in a given situation. Keep an eye on the duration icon at the bottom of the screen to see when it runs out. 

[previewyoutube=-8_iisQMl-w;full][/previewyoutube]

Also in this update is full controller support for Xbox controllers and direct input devices, thanks to the updated navigation control for the menus. Now you can easily enjoy Castle Clamber from the couch in big picture mode in Steam!

We really appreciate all the feedback we get, so make sure to let us know what you think! Thanks for playing, and happy clambering!

notes.title: Beta 1.5 available - Test the potions update!
notes.content: The 1.5 update is now available in beta for anyone who owns the game. This feature update adds new potions which give the player an array of special abilities! Also in the update is a revamped menu layout with full controller support as well as a selection of bug fixes and performance improvements. To try out the beta simply right click the game in your library, choose properties then the beta tab. Select the beta from the drop down list to opt in. If you do try out the beta do please leave some feedback! Many thanks, and happy clambering...

notes.title: 1.4.1922 Released
notes.content:
Another small patch, which addresses the following issues:


 Round timer now pauses when the game is paused
 Map 2 - 26 wasn't teleporting players correctly
 Fixed some crashes in rare cases where animations were played on dead entities


This update also introduces a new file format for maps, as well as some other under-the-hood changes in preparation for the next feature update, 1.5.

As always thanks for playing, and be sure to leave any feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.4.1921 Released
notes.content: This is a small patch that addresses user reported crashes which can happen in some edge cases. It also includes a few tweaks to some maps here and there to improve quality. If you were having issues before please try out this version and let us know your experience! Many thanks, and happy clambering!

notes.title: Update 1.4.1919 Released
notes.content: This is a small update which brings the library, xygine, used by Castle Clamber up to date. The latest version addresses the way memory was assigned to sprite animations and shader uniform bindings. Happy Clambering!

notes.title: Update 1.4.1918 for Windows and macOS
notes.content: This update rolls up some fixes released by the support libraries used by Castle Clamber, generally small improvements in reliability and performance. Happy clambering!

notes.title: Update 1.4.1917
notes.content: This is a small release which attempts to address some user reported bugs such as random  crashes around level 20. Be sure to leave any feedback you might have!

notes.title: Update 1.4.1911 Released
notes.content:
This update is a fairly large overhaul to the game mode, bringing fixes, tweaks and whole new features. The change list includes:


 All new renderer featuring 3D effects and real time lighting
 New animations
 Improved physics
 Many bug fixes and performance improvements incorporated from the latest version of xygine
 New steam features such as network play via remote play together and rich presence
 Updated game play with added high score challenges and time trial leaderboards
 New enemies and bonuses
 More achievements


Hopefully you'll have fun with the new features, especially the time trial - as always if you have any feedback please comment! Happy Clambering!

notes.title: Update 1.2.1901 Released - multiplayer fixes.
notes.content: Fresh out of beta this latest version fixes connectivity issues for online multiplayer, for those who were having trouble with the old lobby system. Collision detection has also been tweaked, as well as compatibility testing been carried out with macOS 10.14 Mojave. The main menu now also includes a handy news feed which displays any announcements in a ticker across the bottom of the screen. Don't forget - if you're hosting a game behind NAT and/or a firewall you will need to forward port 27015 to your host computer. Thank you to everyone for their support and patience, and don't forget we love to hear any feedback you have. Happy clambering!

notes.title: Update 1.1.1811
notes.content: This small update fixes a few cosmetic issues such as incorrect tiles in some maps on the East Wing, and UI graphics appearing on top of the game ending animation.

notes.title: 1.1.1799 Content Update Released
notes.content:
This update not only aims to squash bugs and improve stability, but includes a host of new content:


 3 New Enemies: Swoop the Owl, Doris Poopsnail and Proximity Mines
 All new tutorial to introduce the controls and gameplay, available from the main menu
 Overhauled maps and graphics, new layout for the West Wing, and new sound effects
 Two new achievements: First Steps and Two Can Play That Game


Thanks as always goes to everyone who offered feedback and testing, happy clambering!

notes.title: Build 1.0.1375 Released
notes.content:
The update includes:


    Fixed Memory corruption in data shared between threads
    Improved performance with render textures
    Changed initialisation sequence of Steam servers in multiplayer
    Added highlighting of clickable items in the Help menu


The next update will hopefully be the first content update, including new characters and maps!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1357 Now live
notes.content:
This update brings a few bug fixes, as well as polishes the menu system slightly. Thanks to everyone who offered feedback!

Fixes:

Killing the Squire while wearing the crown now counts towards the achievement
Player rubber banding has been severely reduced when dropping through the bottom of levels
Dropping non-explosive crates on enemies has a much higher chance of defeating them


Menu Improvements:

UI now has a custom cursor
Help(?) menu button now highlights when the mouse cursor is over it
The help menu now has a button to access the advanced options (which are still available by pressing F1)

notes.title: Small update
notes.content: Thanks to everyone who made this a great launch day! I've just released a small update to fix leaderboards potentially hanging in the in-game viewer when selecting 'Friends only' view, bringing the version to 1.0.1325. Thanks for playing, and I look forward to adding new features and polishing any rough edges over the coming months. Happy Clambering!
